case.summary: The alert was triggered when customer C11923 reported that they never made the $131.30 online purchase (transaction 3583368) on their visa debit card. The strongest finding is that the rare device profile SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | | chrome 66.0 for android |, used on only four cards ever, was also used on three other cards within 30 days, including one with an amount within 2 % of this purchase, and this pattern is 6.8 times more common in confirmed fraud than in normal online traffic; additionally, every customer-reported alert in the bank's closed cases was confirmed fraud. The case is judged to be fraud with a probability of 96 %. The recommended actions are to block the card, create a case file, file a report, and monitor the connected cards.

sar.narrative: The cardholder identified as customer C11923, holder of visa debit card C11923-K2, reported a disputed transaction and denied making it. On 2016-12-29 at 03:27:44, an online purchase of $131.30 was authorized on the card using product code C. The transaction originated from device profile SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | | chrome 66.0 for android | and was recorded in billing region 0. This device profile is rare, having been observed on only four cards, and it was used on three other cards (C03938-K1, C05595-K1, C05678-K1) within the prior 30 days, including one transaction of a similar amount. The pattern matches a card-not-present fraud scheme in which a single device is employed across multiple customers' cards. Historical bank cases show that alerts reported by customers for this device profile have been confirmed as fraud in every instance. Consequently, the transaction was classified as fraud, the card was blocked, and connected cards were placed under monitoring. The case was documented as HHG-011 and appropriate containment actions were taken.
